CustomObject.description: SharePoint deal-folder feature (design-requirements-sharepoint-deal-folder.md D7): holds the Graph Site/Drive ids the DealFolderSweepBatch callout targets, an optional parent folder id (blank = drive root), and the Is_Enabled__c kill switch. Read via getOrgDefaults() — zero SOQL, same as Content_Publication_Budget__c. No hardcoded fallback anywhere in Apex: if unset or Is_Enabled__c is false, the feature does nothing and stamps Property__c.SharePoint_Folder_Status__c = 'Skipped'. Custom Setting DATA is not deployable — the org-default row is created at runtime or by hand in Setup as a post-deploy step; do not expect a data row in source control.
CustomObject.label: SharePoint Config
